name: Key Lime Pie Frozen Yogurt
desc: Dairy-free key lime coconut yogurt frozen with lime zest and topped with crushed vanilla wafers.

source.title: Key Lime Pie Frozen Yogurt
source.evidence: Saved Instagram reel; caption and on-screen text captured in the owner's saved-recipes export

ingredients.raw: 3 cups So Delicious Key Lime coconut milk yogurt alternative
ingredients.item: So Delicious Key Lime coconut milk yogurt alternative

ingredients.raw: 1 lime, zested, plus more zest for garnish
ingredients.prep: zested, plus more zest for garnish

ingredients.raw: 1 cup dairy-free vanilla wafer cookies, roughly crushed

steps: Whisk the yogurt, lime zest and agave in a large bowl. Taste and add more agave if you want it sweeter.
Spread in a lidded freezer container, cover, and freeze 4-5 hr, until set.
Let it soften on the counter 5-10 min, then scoop and top with the crushed wafers and extra lime zest.
tips: The creator's website version also whisks in 1/4 cup coconut cream and the lime's juice, then churns it in an ice cream maker with the wafers added in the last minute. Without churning it freezes harder, so give it the full softening time.

references.title: Dairy-Free Key Lime Pie Frozen Yogurt
